designationHistory.name: Pine Island Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Pine Island Reservation by Executive Order 939 on September 15, 1908, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

review.note: Draft described Caloosahatchee NWR (Wilson, 1920, EO 3299), a different refuge. Pine Island itself is a TR reservation of Sept. 15, 1908; renamed Pine Island NWR by Proclamation 2416 (1940).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established by President Woodrow Wilson on July 1, 1920 as a ". . . preserve and breeding ground for native birds." Originally, the Caloosahatchee National Wildlife Refuge consisted of several mangrove islands.
